findings.summary: SECOND consecutive feed-gated council firing died WITHOUT EXECUTING: created 18:06:34Z by the b4dbd709 push touching .github/workflows/cto-council.yml ∈ its own push-path triggers, then queued zero-jobs for ~31m21s and cancelled at 18:37:55Z. Pattern now two-for-two: each mitigation/wake commit's own dispatch has been wasted (b2d747e→council #11 died queued ~4m41s with #12's creation as attributed canceller; b4dbd709→council #12 died queued ~31m). The feed-gate mechanism itself remains untested in execution — no council session has actually run since the gating landed.

HIDDEN GROUP OCCUPANT INFERRED: after council #11 was cancelled at ~18:06:35Z the pending slot should have freed, yet this shell never started during its whole 31-minute life. Therefore an UNSEEN same-group run must have been occupying spider-critical-cto-council from ≈18:06:36Z onward (candidate: an unseen mid-flight council #8/#9/#10 — council sessions can exceed 30 min). Watchdog #80 independently corroborates a non-completed council run at 18:06:47Z. The occupant's identity and outcome are not locally observable.

CANCELLER UNATTRIBUTED despite exhaustive local check: NO main commit between 18:06:32Z and 18:38Z touches ANY council push path (the only intervening commit b985dafe@18:25:31Z touched AGENTS.md alone — not a path-glob match), so no push-spawned successor existed locally; no ~1s correlation partner is visible in supplied bundles. Candidates: manual operator cancel (~18:37Z); a successor arriving via workflow_run completion of some lane finishing around then; an unseen workflow_dispatch. Long-lived unexplained queue death → strictest corpus precedent applies.

~31m21s single-slot group occupancy consumed by a shell that never executed — the largest queue-occupancy waste recorded for a zero-job shell in this memory (vs ~1m41s max previously). Zero tokens, zero artifacts. Blocks any real council review from running in that window if one had been triggered.

failure_signatures: None in-run (no job started). Signature family: conclusion=cancelled + jobs total_count=0 + empty logs.txt with log_status='available' = queued-zero-job shell. NEW extreme variant: ≥30 min queued lifetime.
research_opportunities: Live-API enumeration of councils #8/#9/#10 (created between 17:50Z and 18:01Z) would identify the hidden occupant and close both open attributions in one lookup.

Control-plane self-edit wake policy: workflow files that list themselves in push paths guarantee a wasted dispatch per fix commit during iteration bursts; dispatch-only or debounced self-wake would eliminate the class (same recommendation family as CF-2026-08-26-18 for the curator).

pruning_rationale: Never-started shell (no raw data exists to lose) BUT two material facts remain only inferable from run-object metadata pending live-API adjudication: the identity/outcome of the unseen 31-minute group occupant and the canceller attribution. Follows the strict precedent applied to long-lived unexplained zero-job deaths (runs 32875584974 / 32894986672): hold at false until a live-API pass can adjudicate; all distilled knowledge is already transcribed here either way.
